title: Senior Business Analyst, Technical Services
searchText: Senior Business Analyst, Technical Services MongoDB Partnering with stakeholders in the Technical Services (post-sales support) team, Analytics team, and other teams around the business, this role will surface key insights to drive business decision making. This role requires someone with strong analytical and technical skills, operational experience driving efficiencies, ability to apply a data-first mindset to strategic initiatives, and who is comfortable working across multiple functional areas in a fast-paced, challenging environment. At MongoDB, we are guided by our values : Think Big, Go Far; Make it Matter; Build Together; Embrace the Power of Difference; Be Intellectually Honest; Own What You Do. We are looking for a candidate who is passionate about understanding and communicating customer experiences and business performance through data, and will do so in alignment with our values. We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in New York City for our hybrid working model. Responsibilities Lead in-depth analyses of Technical Services’ business processes, pricing models, and deal structures, including the mechanics of complex transactions; develop strategic insights and solutions that support business scaling and profitability goals Collaborate closely with FP&A to integrate financial and budget considerations into headcount planning and resource allocation for Technical Services, aligning operational initiatives with broader fiscal objectives Facilitate and drive strategic alignment with executive stakeholders, incorporating FP&A insights and objectives Partner with cross-functional leadership to assess and influence corporate initiatives' impact on Technical Services; develop readiness plans and restructuring proposals to support sustainable business growth Architect robust data pipelines in collaboration with Data Analysis, Engineering, and Architecture teams, ensuring the standardization, quality, and precision of data needed for sophisticated business analytics Consult with stakeholders to define strategic data and reporting needs; design advanced dashboards that enable stakeholders to self-serve critical insights for planning performance evaluations and initiative assessments Strengthening team capabilities in FP&A analysis, deal mechanics evaluation, and cross-functional collaboration Skills & Attributes 10+ years of hands-on analytics and business reporting experience (or 5+ years of experience with MBA or equivalent degree), ideally within or partnering with customer-facing organizations Skilled in cleaning, transforming, and integrating data through programmatic methods like Python and SQL, with a demonstrated ability to support advanced FP&A models and planning tools Extensive understanding of complex sales processes, SaaS subscriptions, and deal mechanics with proven skills in employing data analysis techniques to inform high-level executive decisions Proven experience working with senior management and effectively presenting to executive leadership, particularly concerning FP&A strategies, headcount forecasting, and strategic deal structuring Ability to extract and communicate actionable insights from diverse data sets, driving recommendations and strategic planning discussions Demonstrated interest and experience in scoping and building data sets and data products leveraging artificial intelligence technologies / models" Expert in creating dynamic, user-centric dashboards and analytical tools in Tableau that facilitate strategic decision-making and resource planning Exceptional communication skills, capable of translating intricate technical concepts into clear, actionable strategies for varied business audiences Advanced ability to prioritize strategic initiatives, manage conflicting demands in high-stakes environments, and meet critical deadlines Committed to fostering collaborative, innovative, and inclusive environments, actively driving professional growth and acumen within the team Extensive experience with Technical Support businesses/products and familiarity with product management processes is a major advantage About MongoDB MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the database for the AI era, enabling innovators to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified database platform—the most widely available, globally distributed database on the market—helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud database and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. With offices worldwide and nearly 60,000 customers—including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups—relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software. Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB. To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy , we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB , and help us make an impact on the world! MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter. MongoDB, Inc. provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type and makes all hiring decisions without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Req ID: 1263132460 MongoDB’s base salary range for this role is posted below. Compensation at the time of offer is unique to each candidate and based on a variety of factors such as skill set, experience, qualifications, and work location. Salary is one part of MongoDB’s total compensation and benefits package. Other benefits for eligible employees may include: equity, participation in the employee stock purchase program, flexible paid time off, 20 weeks fully-paid gender-neutral parental leave, fertility and adoption assistance, 401(k) plan, mental health counseling, access to transgender-inclusive health insurance coverage, and health benefits offerings. Please note, the base salary range listed below and the benefits in this paragraph are only applicable to U.S.-based candidates. MongoDB’s base salary range for this role in the U.S. is: $97,000 — $189,000 USD Partnering with stakeholders in the Technical Services (post-sales support) team, Analytics team, and other teams around the business, this role will surface key insights to drive...
